treeNote: Phases 1-3.2 and 4 remain uncommitted in the working tree. The Phase 5 baseline was captured with tests/palaceStability.ui.cjs on that pre-Phase-5 tree (the suite always prints RESULTS), then the Phase 5 edits were applied in place. No stash/reset/clean/commit was performed.

benchmark.harness: tests/fixtures/palaceStability.jsx drives the REAL useMemoryPalace hook and the REAL ChatInterface. Scenario 1 mounts a hook probe; scenarios 2-4 mirror TabPane's wiring (real hook -> real ChatInterface). `freshProvider` reproduces TabPane's pre-Phase-5 fresh activeChatProvider object so the provider contribution can be isolated. tests/fixtures/executionEventsProbe.mjs counts pendingSkillProposals calls. window.addEventListener/removeEventListener are wrapped to count keydown registrations. Force-rerender count = 8.

interpretation.hookIdentity: Baseline: the returned object and the three plain-function closures (prepareMessages/finishMessage/toggle) changed identity on every render; setSessionId/refresh/schedule/measure/noteLivePhase/clearLiveTelemetry were already useCallback-stable. Post-change: zero identity changes over 8 forced rerenders with unchanged inputs, while a real session change still produces a new object (objDelta 2: state update render + settled render).
interpretation.keydownChurn: Baseline: the Ctrl+R generate-shortcut effect re-registered its keydown listener once per forced rerender (8). This was driven by generateReply -> sendMessage -> `palace` (whole object). Post-change with the stabilized hook but a still-fresh provider object the churn remains 8 (proving the provider contribution); with the TabPane provider memoized (production wiring) it drops to 0. The Ctrl+F find effect depends only on findOpen and never churned.
interpretation.skillProposalRecompute: Baseline: pendingSkillProposals ran once per ChatInterface render (8 over 8 rerenders), each call scanning every message and nested step with a localStorage read per propose_skill step. Post-change: 0 recomputations on unrelated rerenders; a decision still triggers exactly one recomputation and updates visibility.
interpretation.freshProviderNote: The fresh-provider result is intentional: it shows object-identity churn is not eliminated by stabilizing the hook alone. TabPane now memoizes activeChatProvider, which is the production fix.
